Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Skip Intro
Metadata.Note: Starts at the title screen: the PlayStation, Japan Studio and FromSoftware logo movies are not shown.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Lamp2Lamp (warp between lamps)
Metadata.Note: Lit lamps offer the other lamps of the same Headstone region, and the Hunter's Dream, without going through the Dream first. Changes the game's event and lamp scripts, so a mod that changes those files takes their place. The new lamp text is English only. Lamp2Lamp by Disschorde: https://www.nexusmods.com/bloodborne/mods/455
Metadata.Author: Disschorde

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Lamp2Lamp: warp to bosses
Metadata.Note: Includes Lamp2Lamp, so it needs no other switch. Moves most boss lamps to the front of their arena, so you can warp to a boss once you have found it, except Rom, Amy, Mico, Celestial Emissary and Orphan. A mod that changes the same map files takes their place. Lamp2Lamp by Disschorde: https://www.nexusmods.com/bloodborne/mods/455
Metadata.Author: Disschorde

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Performance Patch (perf increase)
Metadata.Note: Lighter settings for the renderer and its debug parameters, shorter waits in worker threads, sleeps capped at a few milliseconds and profiling skipped. Changes some visuals.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable SSAO
Metadata.Note: Turns the game's screen-space ambient occlusion off.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable Motion Blur (perf increase)
Metadata.Note: Turns the game's motion blur off, and the velocity pass it needs. Faster.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable AA
Metadata.Note: Turns the game's own anti-aliasing off.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable Dynamic Light Shadows (perf increase)
Metadata.Note: Lights that move (lamps, fire, effects) cast no shadows. Faster.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable Chromatic Aberration
Metadata.Note: No colour fringing at the edges of the picture.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable DoF
Metadata.Note: No depth of field blur.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 50% Text scale
Metadata.Note: The game's text at half its size, for high output resolutions. The scale is the float written at 0x4D2913C.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: FMOD Crash Fix
Metadata.Note: FMOD's channel setup clears the field at +0x170 it left uninitialized, and the channel index is checked as the 16-bit value it is. May leave a sound unplayed.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Model LOD -2 (Highest)
Metadata.Note: Every model at its most detailed level, at any distance. Slower.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Model LOD 1 (Lower)
Metadata.Note: Models one detail level lower than the game picks. Faster.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Model LOD 2 (Lowest)
Metadata.Note: Models two detail levels lower than the game picks. Faster.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Increased Graphics Heap Sizes
Metadata.Note: The game's two graphics heaps at 3952 and 2560 MiB instead of 2287 and 886, for scenes above 1080p. Needs the larger memory pool.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Intel Black Tonemap Fix
Metadata.Note: The tone mapping's colour grading always runs. On Intel processors the flag the game computes for it came out wrong and the picture turned black.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Intel 12th Gen+ SFX workaround
Metadata.Note: Draws no ribbon effects (weapon trails of one kind). Only for the crash some newer Intel processors had there.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable HTTP Requests
Metadata.Note: The game's web requests are not made: the two calls that start them, and the date lookup that stamps them.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: DS1-like physics
Metadata.Note: Corpses and loose objects fly when you hit or run into them, as in Dark Souls.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Lower object/corpse physics
Metadata.Note: Corpses and loose objects barely move when hit or run into.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 30 FPS++
Metadata.Note: The game at its own 30 frames a second with the frame timer's frame skip, sync and buffering settings of the 60 FPS mode and each step taking the measured frame time: lower input delay, the same speed.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 60FPS (no deltatime)
Metadata.Note: The game at 60 frames a second with a fixed step of 1/60 s instead of the measured frame time: cloth and corpses never jump after a stutter, but the game slows down below 60 FPS.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS++
Metadata.Note: The game at 60 frames a second: its frame timer in the 60 FPS mode the game already has, every step it takes per frame and the timings, counts and weights tuned for 30 FPS following the frame time. The engine applies it from the frame-rate setting.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 90 FPS++
Metadata.Note: The game at 90 frames a second: its frame timer in the 60 FPS mode the game already has, every step it takes per frame and the timings, counts and weights tuned for 30 FPS following the frame time. The engine applies it from the frame-rate setting.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Uncap FPS++
Metadata.Note: The game with no frame-rate limit of its own: its frame timer without a minimum frame time or vertical sync, each step taking the frame time the timer measures, and the physics, cloth and the values tuned for 30 FPS set as for 90. The engine applies it from the frame-rate setting, with its own limiter.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Restore Debug Menu (READ NOTES)
Metadata.Note: The developers' debug menu: left of the touchpad (Tab) opens it. It needs the debug font, DbgFont14h.ccm and DbgFont14h.tpf, in dvdroot_ps4/font (Nexus mod #253); the engine leaves the patch out without them.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable Camera Auto Rotation via Movement
Metadata.Note: The camera stops turning by itself as the character moves or nears a wall. The stick and lock-on turn it as usual.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Increased camera distance
Metadata.Note: The follow camera sits further back from the hunter.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: No Rally Decay
Metadata.Note: HP lost to a hit stays recoverable by Rally until you strike back: the Rally window and its decay rates are turned off.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Disable Rally (HP Regain)
Metadata.Note: Striking back regains no HP.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Player No Dead (Read note)
Metadata.Note: The game's debug flag: the hunter takes damage but HP never drops below 1.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Player Stealth (Read note)
Metadata.Note: The game's debug flag: enemies do not see you or react to you unless you attack them.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Player Silent (Read note)
Metadata.Note: The game's debug flag: enemies do not hear you but can still see you.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Sensitive Analog Input (easier to run)
Metadata.Note: The left stick reaches running speed at about 80% of its travel instead of nearly all of it.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Unlock Game Region
Metadata.Note: The game takes the region that lists every language, keeping Cross to confirm. That region has no online server: with online on, the engine leaves this patch out.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Unlock All Languages (Works Online)
Metadata.Note: The European text list becomes the full list, and the voice list the eight languages with their own recordings. The sell region stays the international one, so the EU/US server still matches. Leave Unlock Game Region off.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Bookmark and Capture outputs
Metadata.Note: Screenshots and bookmarks the game writes go to /data/bloodborne/ instead of the PS4 capture folder.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Enemy Control
Metadata.Note: Lock on to an enemy and press R3 to control it; L3 gives control back. Not with the debug camera.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Enable Extra Messenger Skins
Metadata.Note: The game treats its hidden pre-order messenger skins as installed and offers them in the Hunter's Dream: they are in the game's own files, only the licence flags kept them out.
Metadata.Author: distpade (NexusMods)

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 1280x800 Light Grid For SteamDeck (READ NOTES)
Metadata.Note: The light grid's tiles at 1280x800, a single tile for a window of that size: far fewer light draw calls. Use the one that matches your window size, not the render size.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 1080p Light Grid (READ NOTES)
Metadata.Note: The light grid's tiles at 1920x1080, a single tile for a window of that size: far fewer light draw calls. Use the one that matches your window size, not the render size.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 1440p Light Grid (READ NOTES)
Metadata.Note: The light grid's tiles at 2560x1440, a single tile for a window of that size: far fewer light draw calls. Use the one that matches your window size, not the render size.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: 4k Light Grid (READ NOTES)
Metadata.Note: The light grid's tiles at 3840x2160, a single tile for a window of that size: far fewer light draw calls. Use the one that matches your window size, not the render size.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Optimal 1080p
Metadata.Note: The scene, UI and HUD at 1920x1080 with the screen size the rest of the game sizes its buffers from at 640x360.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Restore Debug Camera
Metadata.Note: The game's own debug camera: hold Cross and press L3 to fly it from where the camera is, again to keep it still while the hunter moves, again to go back.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Sprint Fix (High FPS)
Metadata.Note: Sprinting keeps its speed above 60 FPS: the game's check for walking into a wall measured distance per frame (a 30 FPS rule); it divides by the frame's time instead. Goes with the 90, 120 and 144 FPS settings.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Enable Screen Space Reflections (READ NOTE)
Metadata.Note: Screen-space reflections on wet and shiny surfaces, a pass the renderer has but the game never turns on. Slower; not in the original game.
Metadata.Author: Lantern Engine
